caption: Caption
empty_body: Your library fills from Instagram's export of what you've saved. Ask Instagram for it, then bring the ZIP here.
no_recipes_body: Recipes are read from captions, transcripts and on-screen text by the local model. Run {#code}./hikidashi recipe{/code}, or the whole {#code}./hikidashi pipeline{/code}, and they appear here.
import_done_unparsed: Imported {file} via {strategy}: {inserted} new, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged, {unparsed} unparsed
import_landed: Imported {file}. Open Import for the counts.
import_arrives: A saved-only export usually arrives within the hour, as an email with a download link. Hikidashi never asks for your Instagram password.
import_phone_steps: In the Instagram app: your profile, {#b}☰{/b}, {#b}Accounts Centre{/b}, {#b}Your information and permissions{/b}, {#b}Export your information{/b}, {#b}Create export{/b}. Make the same choices, and open the email on the phone to download the ZIP.
import_zone: Drop the ZIP here, or click to choose it
import_zone_touch: Tap to choose your export ZIP
import_zone_hint: The ZIP as Instagram sent it, unopened. Several at once is fine.
import_zone_bad: That doesn't look like a ZIP
import_not_zip: {file} isn't a ZIP. Choose the export ZIP Instagram sent.
sheet_nothing: Nothing fetched for this reel yet.

match.attemptsPlural=one: Could not be fetched — {#b}{reason}{/b} after {attempts} attempt. The caption below came from your export.
match.attemptsPlural=other: Could not be fetched — {#b}{reason}{/b} after {attempts} attempts. The caption below came from your export.

game_said_none: You said this reel shows no game.
recipe_hidden: You marked this as not a recipe, so it is not in Recipes.
recipe_incomplete_check: Part of the recipe is elsewhere, or missing
recipe_incomplete_note: Only part of the recipe is in the post: it points elsewhere for the rest, or leaves out amounts or steps.
recipe_yours_over_model: Your version, kept over the model's.
recipe_read_from: Read from {sources} by the local model.
shop_clear_confirm: Take every recipe off the list, and the ticks with them?
shop_empty_body: Add a recipe from its sheet, or pick several in Recipes, and their ingredients show up here, merged and sorted by aisle.
shop_staples_note: Salt, pepper, oil, water: you probably have them.

match.countPlural=one: Add this recipe to the list
Added {n} recipe to your shopping list.
match.countPlural=other: Added {n} recipes to your shopping list.

logs_lede: The server's log, or the worker's, newest at the bottom. Commands run by hand ({#code}./hikidashi transcribe{/code}, {#code}./hikidashi tag{/code}) print to their own terminal instead.
signin_lede: Each person here has a library of their own. Sign in to see yours.
signin_setup: No admin can sign in yet. Open the setup link from the server's log, or run {#code}./hikidashi user passwd local{/code} on the host.
setup_lede: Choose the name and password you'll sign in with. The reels already here become your library, and you can invite others after.
setup_no_token: This link has no setup token. Copy the whole link from the server's log.
invite_lede: You've been invited to this Hikidashi. Your library starts empty: import your own Instagram export to fill it.
invite_closed: This invite link has expired or has been used. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
account_no_auth: Nobody signs in on this server, so everyone who opens it shares one library. Start it with {#code}HIKIDASHI_AUTH=local{/code} to give each person their own.
handle_hint: Shown on your account. Yours to say: Hikidashi never checks it with Instagram.
password_changed: Password changed. You're signed out everywhere else.
people_lede: Everyone with an account. Each has a library of their own; a reel two people saved is fetched and transcribed once.
invites_lede: There is no sign-up: each link makes one account and lasts 7 days. Anyone who has it can use it, so send it only to the person it's for.
invites_new: New link, shown only this once:
copy_selected: Couldn’t copy here, so the text is selected: press Ctrl+C (⌘C on a Mac) to copy it.
copy_https: Browsers only let a page use the clipboard over HTTPS; a reverse proxy in front of Hikidashi gives it that.
tokens_lede: For scripts, monitors and assistants that use Hikidashi without a browser. They send the token as {#code}Authorization: Bearer <token>{/code} and act as you, with only the scopes you tick. Keep a token as you would a password.
tokens_placeholder: What it is for, such as monitor
tokens_read_library: see your reels, tags, recipes and lists
tokens_read_admin: see the server: the pipeline, logs and everyone's accounts
tokens_write_admin: change the server and other people's accounts too
tokens_life_hint: No token lasts more than {days} days, and none can be extended: make a new one instead.
tokens_new: Token for {name}, shown only this once:
tokens_revoked: {name} is revoked: anything using it is refused from now on.
sheet_remove_confirm: Remove it from your library? Anyone else who saved it keeps it. If nobody does, its video and thumbnail are deleted.
signin_proxy: The proxy in front of this server signs you in, and it didn't say who you are. Sign in there, then reload this page.
account_proxy: Signed in as {name} by the proxy in front of this server.
count_no_places: No reels with a place match that filter
no_places_body: Places come from captions: a 📍 pin, a street address, a {#b}Where:{/b} line. Run {#code}./hikidashi places{/code}, or the whole pipeline ({#code}./hikidashi pipeline{/code}), and they appear here.
map_unplaced: {count} could not be found, or not surely enough to pin
map_no_geocoder: Nothing is on the map yet: no geocoder is set up. Set {#code}HIKIDASHI_GEOCODER{/code} and run {#code}./hikidashi places{/code}.
map_none: None of these are on the map yet. Run {#code}./hikidashi places{/code} to look them up.
map_near_me_failed: Could not tell where you are: {error}
map_near_me_insecure: Your browser only shares your location with a page served over HTTPS.
export_lede: Download your library, or part of it, in formats other tools read. The file is made when you click, from the library as it is now. The Export button above the grid does the same for whatever it shows, and a reel's sheet for that reel.
export_recipes_jsonld_hint: The format recipe sites embed. Paste one into Mealie's "Import from HTML or JSON".
export_recipes_nextcloud_hint: A Nextcloud Cookbook ZIP, with photos. In Mealie, upload it under Data Migrations as Nextcloud Cookbook, not under Backups. In Tandoor, Import it as Nextcloud Cookbook.
export_recipes_paprika_hint: A .paprikarecipes file, with photos. Mealie (under Data Migrations, as Paprika) and Tandoor import it too, and keep the servings.
export_markdown_hint: A note per reel, linked by tag, author and collection: unzip it into a vault. To update a vault in place and keep your own notes, use {#code}hikidashi export markdown{/code}.
export_json_hint: Every reel, its tag, collections, text and recipe, for scripts.
export_csv_hint: The same, one row per reel, for spreadsheets.
export_media_hint: These make the file much bigger: hundreds of megabytes with images, and gigabytes with videos.
pl_lede: Each stage runs on new reels as they arrive, in a worker beside the server. A reel waits at a stage until the stages before it are done with it.
pl_none: No worker has checked in, so new reels are not being processed. {#code}./hikidashi start{/code} runs one beside the server; {#code}./hikidashi worker{/code} runs one on its own.
pl_runs_none: Runs no stages on this host
pl_stopped_at: Stopped {ago}, and said so before it went.
pl_lost_body: Last checked in {ago}, and never said it was stopping: it crashed, was killed, or its host is off.
pl_legend: Waiting: an earlier stage still has them to do. Failed: tried {attempts} times without finishing, and not offered again until the stage changes or you retry them.
pl_embed_captions: Embed: no worker can transcribe or tag now, so new reels are embedded from their captions, and again as transcripts and summaries arrive.
pl_retried: {stage}: the failed reels will be tried again.
pl_fetch_retried: The downloads that ran out of tries will be tried again.
pl_tokens_lede: A desktop with a GPU can transcribe, read on-screen text, tag and find recipes for this server whenever it's on. Make a token for it here, then start {#code}hikidashi worker{/code} there with it. Fetching and embedding stay on this server.
pl_token_new: Token for {name}, shown only this once:
pl_token_command: Run this on that machine, from a Hikidashi checkout of the same release:
pl_token_docker: Under Docker, set the same two values for {#code}docker-compose.worker.yml{/code}. Use the address that machine reaches this server at, if it differs from this one.
pl_token_revoked: {name}'s token is revoked: a worker using it is refused from now on.
pl_tokens_none: No tokens, so no worker on another machine can connect.
pl_api_tokens_lede: Everyone's tokens for scripts, which each person makes on {#b}Your account{/b}. Each reads only its owner's library; only an admin's, given an admin scope, reaches the server. The tokens themselves are never shown again.
pl_api_token_revoked: {owner}'s token {name} is revoked: anything using it is refused from now on.
about_license: Free for any noncommercial use, under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.
about_not_affiliated: Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.
ai_lede: Hand transcription, on-screen text, tags and recipes to a hosted AI service instead of waiting for a worker. Off by default: nothing is sent anywhere until a switch is turned on.
ai_applies_mine: Your reels are processed by your hosted AI.
ai_applies_workers: Your reels are processed by workers only.
ai_use_hint: System default follows whatever the admin has chosen. Hosted AI sends your reels to a provider you set up below, with your own key. Workers only: nothing of yours is sent, and nothing is billed to you; a reel someone else also saved may still be processed by their hosted AI, and nothing in the request says you saved it.
ai_on_done: Turned on. New reels go to the API as they are ready.
ai_off_done: Turned off. Requests in flight finish; everything else goes back to workers.
ai_switch_hint: While it is on, the API takes new reels as soon as they are ready, so a worker that checks in later finds none of them. It turns itself off if the key is rejected, the quota is used up or the monthly budget is reached.
ai_unpriced: No price known for {models}: counted as nothing.
ai_no_music_guard: This model gives no segment timings, so music-only reels may get invented lyrics.
ai_key_saved: Key saved. It is never shown again.
ai_language_hint: An ISO code, as en or ja; empty to let the model detect it.
ai_privacy: What is sent: the reel's audio for transcription, frames for on-screen text, and its caption, hashtags, transcript and on-screen text for tags and recipes.
ai_privacy_shared: A reel is processed once for everyone who saved it, by whichever API takes it first.
pipeline_api_line: {waiting} waiting · {in_flight} in flight · {spent} USD this month
pipeline_api_hosted: a hosted worker: {spent} USD this month
tokens_read_ai: see your AI provider settings and usage
tokens_write_ai: change them, and turn your API on or off, which spends money
ai_admin_hint: This is the system default: everyone who keeps System default on their account page follows it. Anyone can choose their own instead, you included.
ai_system_hosted: Hosted AI is the system default, and it is on.
ai_hosted_not_started: Hosted AI is chosen, and not started yet: finish setting it up below, then turn it on. Until then, workers process the reels.
ai_applies_default_hosted: Your reels follow the system default: hosted AI ({providers}).
ai_applies_default_workers: Your reels follow the system default: workers.
ai_default_lede: How the reels of everyone on System default are processed: workers, or hosted AI with the server's own provider and key. Your own library follows your choice on your account page, like everyone else's.
